page_title: Hopformer: Homogeneity-Pursuit Transformer for Time Series Forecasting
subject: Hopformer
statement: Hopformer introduces a two-stage framework for multivariate time series forecasting with high-dimensional covariates, combining Sparsity Pattern Aggregation with a LoRA-fine-tuned Transformer.

page_title: Hopformer: Homogeneity-Pursuit Transformer for Time Series Forecasting
subject: Hopformer
statement: The paper proves that Hopformer's Sparsity Pattern Aggregation achieves near-optimal bias-variance trade-off via an oracle inequality.

page_title: Hopformer: Homogeneity-Pursuit Transformer for Time Series Forecasting
subject: Hopformer
statement: Hopformer provides generalization bounds for the second stage under dependent time series data.

page_title: Hopformer: Homogeneity-Pursuit Transformer for Time Series Forecasting
subject: Hopformer
statement: Hopformer sets new state of the art, improving MASE by average of 6.56% across synthetic and real-world forecasting benchmarks.

page_title: Synthetic Speech, Real Signal: Paralinguistic Preservation and Cross-Lingual Augmentation via Voice Cloning
subject: voice cloning
statement: The paper benchmarks eight voice cloning models on five paralinguistic tasks across public and clinical datasets, finding most preserve paralinguistic signal with modest degradation.

page_title: Synthetic Speech, Real Signal: Paralinguistic Preservation and Cross-Lingual Augmentation via Voice Cloning
subject: voice cloning
statement: Training on cloned English clinical speech into Japanese outperforms raw cross-lingual transfer for depression and anxiety detection on real Japanese speech.

page_title: Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation via Byte-Prefix Marginalization
subject: Byte-Prefix Marginalization
statement: Byte-Prefix Marginalization (BPM) re-expresses the teacher's next-token distribution over student vocabulary in shared byte space, producing vocabulary-complete, byte-aligned targets.

page_title: Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation via Byte-Prefix Marginalization
subject: Byte-Prefix Marginalization
statement: BPM consistently outperforms current cross-tokenizer methods, improving six-benchmark average by 3.7-6.6 points over strongest baselines across multiple teacher models.

page_title: SiPhy: Single-Image Physical Property Reasoning
subject: SiPhy
statement: SiPhy introduces unified framework for single-image physical property reasoning aligning 3D-aware visual cues and depth with language-based material knowledge via VLM grounding.

page_title: SiPhy: Single-Image Physical Property Reasoning
subject: SiPhy
statement: SiPhy achieves state-of-the-art single-image performance, improving mass MnRE by up to 93% versus PUGS and reducing density MAE by 35.5% versus NeRF2Physics.

page_title: SiPhy: Single-Image Physical Property Reasoning
subject: SiPhy
statement: SiPhy lowers Young's modulus error by 23.5% compared to prior work and validates on real hand-object interaction datasets as data annotation engine.

page_title: Learning Structural Convergence: A Neuro-Symbolic Benchmark for Temporal Reasoning
subject: TRACTA
statement: TRACTA is a synthetic benchmark for temporal structural reasoning in high-complexity event-driven systems with three tasks: early_warning, pattern_detection, and run_classification.

page_title: Learning Structural Convergence: A Neuro-Symbolic Benchmark for Temporal Reasoning
subject: TRACTA
statement: Semantically grounded trajectories achieve highest aggregate point estimates on temporal structural reasoning compared to raw-event neural models and semantic baselines.

page_title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
subject: IDEAgent
statement: IDEAgent introduces multi-agent framework managing evolution of research ideas through lineages, jointly optimizing Quality via multi-objective feedback and Diversity via sequential memory.

page_title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
subject: IDEAgent
statement: IDEAgent outperforms best baseline by 3.89x on Yield across 32 topics spanning 8 Computer Science domains.

page_title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
subject: IDEAgent
statement: IDEAgent achieves non-zero Yield on 8x more topics than baseline approaches.

page_title: Agentic Root Cause Analysis through Evidence-Grounded Reasoning
subject: AgentRCA

page_title: Agentic Root Cause Analysis through Evidence-Grounded Reasoning
subject: AgentRCA
statement: AgentRCA achieves diagnostic performance competitive with fully supervised baselines without fault-specific training on real-world multiphase-flow facility and chemical plant.

page_title: Agentic Root Cause Analysis through Evidence-Grounded Reasoning
subject: AgentRCA
statement: AgentRCA produces transparent reasoning traces that explicitly link observed symptoms to underlying physical causes.

page_title: A Self-Calibrating Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Edge Resource Allocation

statement: Self-calibrating framework achieves 91.7% higher accuracy for zero-knowledge workload resource prediction compared to baseline LLM agents.

page_title: A Self-Calibrating Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Edge Resource Allocation
subject: self-calibrating agentic framework
statement: The framework improves prediction speed by 71.7% compared to pure profiling approaches.

page_title: grapheme-kit: Grapheme-Level Metrics and Text Processing for Multilingual NLP
subject: grapheme-kit

page_title: grapheme-kit: Grapheme-Level Metrics and Text Processing for Multilingual NLP
subject: grapheme-kit
statement: grapheme-kit provides improved grapheme processing for Tamil and Sinhala, including accurate grapheme cluster identification and composition/decomposition utilities.

page_title: grapheme-kit: Grapheme-Level Metrics and Text Processing for Multilingual NLP
subject: grapheme-kit
statement: Through OCR case study, grapheme-level metrics provide more faithful evaluation of complex scripts compared to Unicode-based metrics.

page_title: Phylogenetic signal in marine mammal and bird vocalizations captured by audio foundation models
subject: audio foundation models
statement: Foundation models (CLAP r=0.82, BEATs-bio r=0.82, AST r=0.74) recover strong phylogenetic signal in marine mammal vocalizations, far outperforming hand-crafted MFCC features (r=0.040).

page_title: Phylogenetic signal in marine mammal and bird vocalizations captured by audio foundation models
subject: audio foundation models
statement: Domain-specific pretraining (BirdNET for birds, BEATs-bio) does not improve recovery of phylogenetic signal compared to general-purpose foundation models on bird vocalizations.

page_title: Susceptible Reservoir Architectures for Regime-Conditional Volatility Forecasting
subject: SUSA

page_title: Susceptible Reservoir Architectures for Regime-Conditional Volatility Forecasting
subject: SUSA
statement: SUSA performs competitively with GARCH, achieving statistically significant QLIKE improvements for specific assets (IWM, XLP).

page_title: Susceptible Reservoir Architectures for Regime-Conditional Volatility Forecasting
subject: SUSA
statement: Stacked ensemble combining SUSA forecasts with HARQ-style predictions improves mean QLIKE by 0.0116 over strongest constituent, winning in 75% of test scenarios.

page_title: Interpretable EEG biomarkers with bag-of-waves: Spatial and temporal waveform dictionaries for low-data regimes
subject: bag-of-waves

page_title: Interpretable EEG biomarkers with bag-of-waves: Spatial and temporal waveform dictionaries for low-data regimes
subject: bag-of-waves
statement: bag-of-waves achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art deep and foundation models across single-channel genotype clustering, dementia classification, and clinical event benchmarks.

page_title: Interpretable EEG biomarkers with bag-of-waves: Spatial and temporal waveform dictionaries for low-data regimes
subject: bag-of-waves
statement: bag-of-waves provides full interpretability with fraction of model parameters: every atom recovers known clinical morphologies, excelling in low-data regimes where deep models fail.

page_title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
subject: CausalForge
statement: CausalForge augments kernel verification with statement audit comparing each formal theorem against informal claim to ensure faithfulness of formalization.

page_title: Quantum Spectral Model: Data Reuploading with Input-Conditioned Frequency Support

page_title: Quantum Spectral Model: Data Reuploading with Input-Conditioned Frequency Support

page_title: PinEqualizer: Full Funnel Content Exploration and Debiasing System at Pinterest
subject: PinEqualizer
